en.archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Showa American Story delayed to October 2027

entries.headline: Showa American Story delayed to October 28, 2027
entries.summary: NEKCOM Games has delayed Showa American Story to October 28, 2027 for PC via Steam and PlayStation 5; two independent outlets report the new date.
entries.verification: Two independent reports were opened and agree on the revised release date; the platform list comes from AUTOMATON.
entries.timeNote: The selected source timestamp converts to 2026-11-24 22:41 Beijing time, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Nioh 3 and its Complete Edition come to Xbox Series X|S on January 28, 2027
entries.summary: Xbox says Nioh 3 and Nioh 3: Complete Edition will launch for Xbox Series X|S on January 28, 2027, marking the series' Xbox debut. The Complete Edition contains the base game and both expansions.
entries.verification: Verified against the first-party Xbox Wire announcement.
entries.timeNote: The selected source timestamp converts to 2026-11-25 03:00 Beijing time, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: EVO Japan 2027 announces seven main-stage games
entries.summary: EVO Japan 2027 has announced seven main-stage games for the April 29–May 1 event at Tokyo Big Sight, including the newly added MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls.
entries.verification: Two independent reports were opened and agree on the event dates, venue, and lineup announcement.
entries.timeNote: The selected source timestamp converts to 2026-11-24 20:45 Beijing time, inside the fixed edition window.

sourceLabels.label: 電ファミニコゲーマー News

entries.headline: NVIDIA releases driver 621.40 to address excessive SSD writes
entries.summary: GeForce Game Ready Driver 621.40 is reported to fix excessive SSD writes caused by NVDisplay.Container.exe while a PC is idle.
entries.verification: Based on an opened AUTOMATON report relaying NVIDIA's patch notes; this is not upgraded to first-party verification.
entries.timeNote: The selected source timestamp converts to 2026-11-25 08:39 Beijing time, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Four-player draining simulator Drain The Pit announced
entries.summary: Torvex Interactive has announced Drain The Pit for PC via Steam. It supports solo play and online co-op for up to four players, has no release date, and currently offers a free itch.io playtest.
entries.verification: The opened report supports the developer, platform, player count, release status, and playtest.
entries.timeNote: The selected source timestamp converts to 2026-11-24 12:16 Beijing time, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Nioh 3 DLC 2, Bloody Insurrection, launches December 17
entries.summary: Koei Tecmo says Nioh 3's second expansion, Bloody Insurrection, will launch on December 17. Its story is set in Shimabara in 1638 and continues the conspiracy from the first expansion.
entries.verification: The opened report supports the expansion number, title, date, and setting; no platforms are inferred.
entries.timeNote: The selected source timestamp converts to 2026-11-24 10:41 Beijing time, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Symphony of War II: Dominion announced for PC in 2027
entries.summary: Hooded Horse has announced Dancing Dragon Games' turn-based strategy RPG Symphony of War II: Dominion for Steam and GOG in 2027, adding naval warfare and more than 100 classes.
entries.verification: The opened report supports the developer, publisher, platforms, year, and named features.
entries.timeNote: The selected source timestamp converts to 2026-11-25 08:42 Beijing time, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: DEAD OR ALIVE 6 Last Round gets a free 30th-anniversary update
entries.summary: Koei Tecmo and Team NINJA have released a series anniversary trailer and a free DEAD OR ALIVE 6 Last Round update with costumes for 10 characters, an all-character accessory, a stage, music, and titles.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report supports the free update and its listed content.
entries.timeNote: The selected source timestamp converts to 2026-11-24 15:00 Beijing time, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Hot-spring life sim Fluffy Hot Spring announced for PC
entries.summary: Sinkhole Studio and Moonlab Studio have announced Fluffy Hot Spring, a life simulation game about running a bathhouse. It is coming to PC via Steam with no release date announced.
entries.verification: The opened report supports the developers, premise, platform, and undated status.
entries.timeNote: The selected source timestamp converts to 2026-11-24 14:20 Beijing time, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Mario Kart World update 1.9.0 adds rallies and courses
entries.summary: Nintendo has released Mario Kart World update 1.9.0 for Nintendo Switch 2, adding Feather Rally and Lucky Cat Rally to Knockout Tour along with new courses.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report supports the version, named rallies, courses, and platform.
entries.timeNote: The selected source timestamp converts to 2026-11-25 09:05 Beijing time, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Free zombie adventure Terminus: Day Zero launches on Steam
entries.summary: Longplay Studios has released Terminus: Day Zero for free on Steam. The game follows a young girl unable to fight zombies through the first day of the outbreak.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report supports the developer, free Steam release, and premise.
entries.timeNote: The selected source timestamp converts to 2026-11-24 12:43 Beijing time, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Short horror game Missing Number 343 launches on Steam
entries.summary: Vexrane has released the short horror game Missing Number 343 on Steam. Players restore a missing man's camera records and use photos and timestamps to trace his movements.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report supports the developer, platform, launch, and core mechanic.
entries.timeNote: The selected source timestamp converts to 2026-11-24 15:10 Beijing time, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Queen's Domain passes 300,000 copies sold
entries.summary: Future Friends Games says Freshly Baked Games' first-person RPG Queen's Domain has sold more than 300,000 copies across PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch 2.
entries.verification: The opened report supports the sales milestone, companies, and platforms.
entries.timeNote: The selected source timestamp converts to 2026-11-24 15:52 Beijing time, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: GameCube Nintendo Classics grows to 10.9 GB
entries.summary: After Wave Race: Blue Storm was added, the Nintendo Switch 2-only GameCube Nintendo Classics app grew from 9.5 GB to 10.9 GB.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report supports the added game, platform restriction, and size change.
entries.timeNote: The selected source timestamp converts to 2026-11-24 17:03 Beijing time, inside the fixed edition window.
